lemma.note: cq1 report w11/32 (AM-178-fol 2-345:5 før 'journey'). Menota lemma 'for' occurs only in late Norwegian/Icelandic documents (AM-178-fol, DG-8-OHleg, HolmPerg-4-fol, DG-4at7-Streng) as the spelling of fǫr 'journey' (forms før, farar, forena); the furrow noun for (*furhs < *perḱ-) is not attested there. fǫr is unmapped in Menota; same decision.

proto.note: cq1 report w11/36 (Wolf-Aug-9-10-4to 51v:25 fleins). Kaikki Proto-Germanic *flainaz 'hook, spear-tip' < PIE *pleyn- 'metal arrow' < *(s)pel- 'to split'; the automatic link hit the homonym *spel- 'say aloud' (pie-root-spel-say_aloud). The lexicon has no *(s)pel- 'split' entry: unmapped, not reassigned.
